canonical_question: Why can crop rankings fail to determine optimal land allocation?
positive_claim_target: Ordinal ranks omit cardinal margins, feasible actions and optimizer selection; each omission has a distinguishable effect under declared conditions
theory_requirement: Identification region; rank-preservation conditions; margin and local-pressure decomposition
confirmatory_simulation: M0 ranking to M1 margins to M2 operational constraints with controlled block additions and face audit
empirical_relevance: Pre-decision score gaps, acreage-share transitions, aggregation and heterogeneity; no revealed-optimum claim
manuscript_sections: Conceptual framework; Ranking reversal mechanisms; Empirical validation
claim_gate: Theory proof plus converged controlled simulation; empirical result labelled observed consistency only

canonical_question: How do downside risks change allocation?
positive_claim_target: A binding loss-CVaR constraint can contract the feasible set and change allocation, but effects are parameter- and active-set-dependent
theory_requirement: Risk-slack invariance; conditional risk-feasible-set results; complete tail subgradient
confirmatory_simulation: M2 versus M3 across fixed alpha/kappa grids with common scenarios, direct CVaR and dual checks
empirical_relevance: Historical downside-exposure associations may be tested; farmer CVaR limits remain unobserved
manuscript_sections: Stochastic optimization model; Ranking reversal mechanisms; Numerical experiments
claim_gate: No crop-specific monotonicity without proof; all precision and convergence gates pass

canonical_question: How do operational constraints create ranking reversal?
positive_claim_target: Budget, rotation, contracts and bounds have separable forcing, pressure and interaction signatures
theory_requirement: Constraint classification; KKT pressure terms; selection-robust counterfactual attribution
confirmatory_simulation: One-at-a-time and factorial tightness experiments with slacks, duals, active sets and optimal-face ranges
empirical_relevance: Use lagged shares and authoritative constraint proxies only with status tags; private constraints remain unavailable
manuscript_sections: Ranking reversal mechanisms; Numerical experiments; Empirical validation
claim_gate: Constraint effect isolated in design and empirical analogue does not exceed observability

positive_claim_target: Variance diversification can coexist with tail concentration and true-law regret under dependence misspecification
theory_requirement: Non-equivalent diversification definitions; conditional tail-order or regret results
confirmatory_simulation: True-versus-assumed dependence frontiers, marginal tail contributions, concentration and regret with null cases
empirical_relevance: Synchronized longer-horizon profit outcomes can describe tail co-movement; welfare requires a validated decision model
manuscript_sections: Ranking reversal mechanisms; Numerical experiments; Discussion
claim_gate: True-law evaluation is predeclared; pseudo-diversification is never a sufficient welfare or exclusion claim

positive_claim_target: Information value is zero without actionability and can rise with flexibility only under explicit conditions; substitution remains possible
theory_requirement: Decision timing; general VOI bound; sufficient complementarity conditions or bounded hypothesis
confirmatory_simulation: Fully crossed signal precision by nested flexibility design with policy actionability and interaction intervals
empirical_relevance: Timestamped forecasts and flexibility measures are required; causal complementarity needs exogenous variation
claim_gate: Ignore-signal policy and nested sets verified; positive interaction promoted only if theory and precision gates pass
